sourceEvidence.title: Operations Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
Cordica Medical is seeking an experienced Operations Manager to lead manufacturing and maintenance operations at our Sunrise, Florida location. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives on driving operational excellence, building strong teams, and delivering results in a regulated manufacturing environment.

As Operations Manager, you'll take direct ownership of plant performance ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production that meets our demand plan while upholding the highest engineering, quality, and regulatory standards. You'll lead manufacturing, maintenance, warehouse, area managers, engineers, and other site teams, with full responsibility across hiring, performance management, coaching, and employee development.
